scope: strict-R3 side-local short-path infrastructure; no short model or live short execution was trained, sealed, or promoted
ordered_delivery: policy-label materialisation and source-aligned policy-outcome assembly
base/residual/consensus training and Geometry/K9 side lineage
MC1/BCF mapping, policy HPO, and Adaptive Exit side contracts
portfolio auction and Kraken Futures execution side direction

invariants.side_local_artifacts: Every new short pathway requires a distinct side=short artifact; long legacy artifacts cannot satisfy a short request.
invariants.policy_labels: The coarse frozen-policy materialiser applies signed high/low stop and favourable-path logic and retains invalid paths as invalid supervision.
invariants.geometry: Frozen Geometry/K9 includes its fit side and all current/upstream/conversion consumers reject a mismatched side. It is not re-fit monthly.
invariants.stacking: Current, upstream, conversion, MC1, and BCF inputs are asserted side-local at every supervised or scoring boundary.
invariants.execution: Short preflight sells through bids, uses buy-side exit VWAP, installs a reduce-only buy protective stop with symmetric stop-safety checks, debits only adverse short delay and sell impact, and requires an exactly side-matched sealed inference and activation contract.
invariants.promotion: Short remains fail-closed until separately materialised labels, side-specific feature/consensus contracts, Geometry/K9, base/residual/BCF/MC1/A5/Adaptive Exit bundles, inference bundle, and execution authorization are produced.

validation.syntax: Python compile parse passed for the nine repaired side-aware modules
validation.known_unrelated_suite_failures: A broader existing email-rendering subset has three failures in test_inference_masking_and_oco.py concerning changed email strings/categories. Those files were not modified by this side-local implementation.

quarantined_noncanonical_paths.exact_1m_rich_extensions_hpo: Explicitly remains an offline long-only research funnel. It cannot train or promote a short policy and has no inference or execution authority.
quarantined_noncanonical_paths.simultaneous_long_and_short_live_service: A side-local live service rejects an opposite-side exchange position. Concurrent two-sided trading requires a separately designed unified executor and shared state; it is not implied by this work.

live_effect: No exchange-facing configuration or authorization was changed. Because the executor source is hash-bound, an existing long execution contract will now fail closed until a separately reviewed long successor is resealed with the unchanged-long behavioural parity evidence. No short execution configuration was created.
